_meta.scope: prior present AND draft silent (the Eq. 3 coverage scope)
_meta.calib: fitted on the sw validation split, n=464 in-scope pairs
_meta.pos_rule: tau_pos = confidence at P(pos|c) = base_in_scope; looser than P=0.5, so more persistent findings are covered and tagged 'unchanged'
_meta.neg_rule: tau_neg = confidence at P(pos|c) = base_in_scope/2; the resolved (negative) branch
_meta.fields: n = in-scope validation pairs; base_in_scope = positive rate in scope; open_pos/open_neg = whether that branch is enabled for this finding; _alt_tau_pos_P50 = the alternative operating point at P=0.5, reported in App. G, not adopted
_meta.closed: pleural_effusion and consolidation are absent / closed: too few clean validation pairs (App. C)
